jobs.description:
Are you motivated to work in fast-paced environment? You will work in the Presentations Team within our Investment Banking division, creating high-quality presentation materials for clients using PowerPoint.

グローバルバンキング部門（投資銀行本部）のプレゼンテーションチームにて、資料作成・改善を担うパワーポイントデザイナーを募集しています。

Main responsibilities:
• Create PowerPoint presentations and pitchbooks for clients, following UBS’s official style guidelines
• Work closely with bankers in Japan and sometimes with teams overseas
• Learn new skills and contribute to successful pitch materials

職務内容

クライアント向けの商談や提案に使用される資料の作成・ブラッシュアップをご担当いただきます。複雑な情報を整理し、分かりやすく視覚的に伝わるスライドへと仕上げていただきます。
デザインの観点から情報の伝え方を改善するための提案にも関わっていただきます。

主な業務内容：
- プレゼンテーション資料およびピッチ資料の作成・ブラッシュアップ
- 情報を分かりやすく伝えるためのレイアウト、チャート、スライドの設計
- 既存資料の改善・磨き込み（可読性・一貫性・全体品質の向上）
- 社内関係者と連携し、目的や要件を理解した上で資料に反映
- デザインの観点から改善提案および実装
- 複数案件に対応しながら、短納期でも高品質なアウトプットを提供

jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Are you curious about how a global bank manages compliance, operational risk, and regulatory obligations? Do you enjoy working with data, processes, and controls while learning how risk frameworks support business decisions? Are you interested in developing a strong foundation in risk and governance?

We’re looking for a Junior Talent Program (JTP) Intern to:

Support compliance & operational risk control (C&ORC) activities across GCORC teams.

Assist in maintaining and documenting risk, control, and governance frameworks in line with internal policies and regulatory standards.

Help with data analysis, reporting, and monitoring activities related to non‑financial risk.

Contribute to the preparation of materials, dashboards, and documentation used to support risk management and oversight.

jobs.description:
As a Special Client Situations Desk (SCSD) Client Account Manager, you will be responsible for the accounts transferred to you for exit purposes.
This includes following up with clients on top up/closure instructions (e.g. Execution of securities and forex transactions to facilitate account closure)

You will:
• act as the primary or secondary point of contact for the clients; manage daily administration, client servicing and attend to compliance requirements
• be the liaison between the various operational sub-teams to ensure smooth account closure
• ensure strict compliance with all internal policies and external regulations and legal guidelines are adhered to
• ensure the occurrence of errors and operational problems are minimized, promptly and properly document any issues that occur

• Identify, understand, and manage the risks associated with your business and function
• Collaborate across teams and functions to deliver the most effective solutions and courses of action

jobs.title: Senior Electronic Algorithmic Trading Quantitative Analyst

titleByLocale.it: Senior Electronic Algorithmic Trading Quantitative Analista
titleByLocale.en: Senior Electronic Algorithmic Trading Quantitative Analyst
titleByLocale.de: Senior Electronic Algorithmic Trading Quantitative Analyst
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Electronic Algorithmic Trading Quantitative Analyste

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about performing research, analyzing data and coding up improvements to complex algorithmic trading strategies? We're looking for someone to analyze, adapt and improve the quantitative performance of UBS’s suite of agency algorithmic trading and smart order routing strategies.

The successful candidate will primarily:
• perform thorough research on areas such as market microstructure and market impact analysis.
• perform Transaction Costs Analysis (TCA) to minimize executions costs.
• improve consistency of algo performance and reduce outliers and risk, particularly during significant unscheduled as well as scheduled events e.g. index rebalance events.
• design and spec new trading strategies with a particular focus on low latency trading strategies.
• analyze trading patterns and trends within market data (L2 or L3 format).
• employ modern data analytical tools such as machine learning but in a controlled and practical way.
• adapt algorithms to adjust to new markets, venues, order types, asset classes and regulation.
• generate intraday trading signals and volume forecasts from microseconds to minutes.
• communicate with internal stakeholders and external clients and vendors to understand business requirements and market trends.
• produce analytics and reports to monitor and benchmark trading performance both internally and for clients

jobs.description:
Do you have a strong trading / technology / analytical background with in-depth knowledge of equity markets and market micro-structure?

• manage the quantitative parameters that drive the overall algorithmic behavior
• provide daily interaction with the equity trading desks, quantitative analysts, and clients to adjust parameters on the back of stock specific news and in advance of special event days to ensure algorithm behavior is aligned with client and market expectations
• apply client specific configuration that enhance client/algorithm specific behavior, manage and prioritize product enhancements, risk management, and conduct data driven analysis to automate and optimize the trading platform and workflows
• manage releases and custom algorithm solutions and provide Real Time management of trading risk and intraday monitoring of the algorithms across all business types, products, and clients
• be responsible for direct interaction with the developers and quantitative analysts surrounding improvement to the algorithmic products including analytics and research
• interact with execution consultants who work directly with external clients to optimize and improve trading experience with UBS
• act as an electronic trading subject matter expertise with ability to serve as real time source of information to users of electronic trading product both internally & externally

jobs.description:
Revolutionize Wealth Management with AI
We’re building modern, world-class AI products that help our Wealth Management advisors serve clients better. You will be responsible for executing our AI strategy and ideating in the rapidly evolving environment of enterprise AI. This is inclusive of chatbots as well as agentic solutions all with the goal of “codifying investment advice” for our advisors and saving them time. You’ll own outcomes end to end, lead people, and partner closely with Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Product Marketing to ship experiences advisors love.

What you’ll do:

• Own an AI product portfolio end to end: define strategy, shape roadmaps, and deliver advisor facing capabilities (e.g., productivity tools, advisor workflows, insights & analytics, chat/assistive tools).
• Define products & features: Develop and maintain technical requirements, user stories, and design documents for product features.
• Design delightful experiences: partner with UX to drive elegant, usable flows; insist on research and measurable UX outcomes
• Ship with quality and compliance: collaborate with Engineering, Data Science, Risk, Legal, and Compliance to meet regulatory and supervisory expectations in wealth management.
• Lead and develop people: hire, coach, and performance manage PMs/POs (and/or cross functional squads); raise the bar on product craft.
• Tell the story: translate complex concepts into crisp narratives for senior stakeholders; influence prioritization with data (adoption, CSAT, etc).
• Continuously improve: instrument, test, learn; run experiments and iterate to drive advisor productivity and client outcomes.
• Analyze trends: Analyze user behavior, market trends, and competitor activity to inform product decisions.
• Scale operating rigor: own backlogs, OKRs, metrics, release readiness, and business change (training, comms, enablement).

jobs.description:
Revolutionize Wealth Management with Digital Solutions & AI
Are you passionate about harnessing innovative technologies and artificial intelligence to drive innovation and growth? Do you have experience in developing AI-powered products that transform industries?
We're building a cutting-edge suite of products, including machine learning and natural language processing to drive competitive advantage for our financial advisors. As a Product Manager, Digital Solutions & AI, you'll play a crucial role in shaping this suite of products and driving their success.

• Own AI but also other digital technology products end-to-end, both internally developed as well as vendor products (e.g M365 Copilot)

• Analyze user behavior, market trends, and competitor activity to inform product decisions.
• Develop and maintain technical requirements, user stories, and design documents for product features.
• Conduct demos and internal training sessions for new products and features

jobs.title: Investment Advisor
jobs.description:
Your role :
Do you have the perfect pitch? Do you follow the markets, even in your spare time?

We’re looking for an investment advisor to:
• Work closely with the Premium Advisory Specialist team in Taiwan & APAC
• Act as the dedicated portfolio specialist for clients with UBS Advice Premium Mandates, providing comprehensive investment advice across various asset classes, guided by Chief Investment Office's Strategic Asset Allocation and Tactical Asset Allocation
• Deliver customized investment proposals directly to clients to match their investment objectives, risk appetite and preferences
• Perform trade executions and regular systematic portfolio reviews to keep clients' investments on track and identify potential risks
• Provide advice based on UBS investment views (through Chief Investment Office) that aims to maximize the client's portfolio performance while being consistent with the client's objectives
• Monitor client portfolios on a regular basis in close co-operation with the client (with regular reviews of client risk profile and investment objectives)
• Pro-actively contact clients with meaningful portfolio updates and provides investment recommendations within a portfolio context and a disciplined / risk-controlled framework
• Responsible for timely and adequate execution, confirmation and supervision of orders given by the client
• Follow developments in the financial markets to maintain an understanding of both current and anticipated trends across relevant markets and asset classes

jobs.description:
Do you want to maximize the benefits of a global franchise for the good of clients? Do you have expertise across a range of asset classes and markets? Do you have a proven track record advising clients in discretionary and advisory portfolios? We're looking for someone to

- act as a Mandate Specialist for Client Advisors in the Southeast Asia (SEA) region to the entire range of discretionary and advisory offerings, with a focus on UBS Manage solutions (discretionary portfolio management)
- drive sales and revenues of UBS Manage together with client advisors
- actively participate in client meetings regarding acquisition, review and retention of above mentioned solutions
- give clients an excellent experience, in collaboration with other specialists, as well as our Chief Investment Office (CIO) and Global Investment Management
- gather client advisor and client insights to guide product development
- work with a team of highly motivated and experienced mandate specialists and help to continuously improve processes through regular best practice exchange
- follow and adhere to the UBS code of ethics and the relevant cross-border regulations

jobs.title: Spécialiste Crédits 80-100%
jobs.description:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé.

En tant que spécialiste crédits, vous serez chargé de :

• traiter les demandes de prêt approuvées à l'échelle nationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la réalisation des projets de nos clients
• préparer les contrats de crédit avec les documents de sûreté appropriés, assurant ainsi la documentation nécessaire à nos prêts
• saisir et gérer les crédits et garanties (p.ex. les cédules hypothécaires, polices et cautions)
• emettre les promesses de paiement et leur exécution
• assurer la correspondance et le dialogue avec les registres fonciers, notaires, banques et compagnies d’assurance, établissant des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires
• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques

• support our private bankers known as Client Advisors in our Greater China desk in Singapore to deliver exceptional client service and experience
• be point-of-entry contact for clients with account queries or orders, stock orders, payments, etc.
• assist with account opening, onboarding, due diligence and monitoring activities
• support with documentation for client meetings, investment proposals and the like
• collaborate with colleagues to ensure that all client accounts comply with legal, compliance and regulatory requirements

Are you a people person? Do you know how to stay calm under pressure? We are looking for someone who can:

• support our private bankers known as Client Advisors who manage comprehensive and complex GFO client books
• assist in credit / structured lending matters, credit analysis to support our clients' lending book
• assist in corporate action matters
• comfortable with complex excel worksheets
• comply with all regulations, policies and standards, contributing to an effective risk culture
• keep accurate, up-to-date client documentation to meet regulatory requirements
• carry out daily transaction processing and complex troubleshooting
• keep in contact with internal and external clients
